title: facelis retusa var. typica
intro: Facelis retusa var. typica, commonly known as Chilca, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. Chilca is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Chilca are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, allowing it to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Chilca include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
